objective: Determine whether a real post-freeze shadow capture flow exists locally and whether its metadata controls could support a future independent instrument.
factor: availability of a qualifying post-freeze shadow capture channel on the frozen repo-local surface
hypothesis: A post-freeze flow exists with immutable physical-document identity, clear consent and retention controls, and a feasible annotation path isolated from model predictions.

semantic_extraction_contract.endpoint_rule: Extract literal Flask Blueprint route decorators and HTTP methods.
semantic_extraction_contract.evidence_rule: Report only tracked source path, line number and matched schema token; never report arbitrary line contents.
semantic_extraction_contract.persisted_field_rule: Extract literal dictionary keys from backend/services/annotation_storage.py and interface field names from frozen TypeScript sources.

dynamic_metadata_contract.annotations: Stat-only aggregate counts, suffix counts, bytes and mtimes; never read or emit names or bytes.
dynamic_metadata_contract.auth_database: Read-only SQLite schema, aggregate row counts and aggregate timestamp ranges; never select or emit row values.
dynamic_metadata_contract.logs: Stat-only recursive aggregate count, bytes and mtime range; never read or emit paths.
dynamic_metadata_contract.environment: Existence boolean for backend/.env only; never open it.
dynamic_metadata_contract.browser_storage: Infer capability from frozen source only; never open browser storage.

classification_contract.flow_exists_with_document_identity: A non-local-only persisted capture flow has at least one aggregate post-freeze record and its frozen persisted schema includes immutable physical-document identity.
classification_contract.flow_exists_without_document_identity: A non-local-only persisted capture flow has at least one aggregate post-freeze record but only fallback grouping identity.
classification_contract.no_flow: No qualifying non-local-only persisted post-freeze flow is evidenced.
classification_contract.instrument_usable: Requires flow_exists_with_document_identity plus explicit consent, image-retention controls and a feasible double-blind annotation path isolated from predictions.
classification_contract.rate_scenario: Six qualified documents per week for eight weeks is descriptive only and cannot be certified without content, deduplication and labels.
classification_contract.hypothesis_supported: True only when instrument_usable is true.

integrity_gates: The surface manifest and all 26 tracked source hashes match.
The candidate manifest and Council synthesis hashes match.
Only the frozen metadata operations are executed.
No user file, image, annotation metadata, log, environment file, browser record, prediction or label is opened.
Dynamic aggregate snapshots remain stable across the audit.
First and replay artifacts are byte-identical.
Runtime and v11 candidate hashes remain unchanged.
No training, inference, holdout access, final-test access or promotion occurs.
forbidden_actions: Read any byte from backend/annotations, any log file, backend/.env or browser storage.
Emit dynamic file names, analysis ids, user ids, emails, tokens, labels, predictions or submitted content.
Treat analysis_id, session_id or device_id as physical-document identity.
Infer class coverage from metadata-only evidence.
Acquire images or detailed external records.
Change any provenance attribution, exclusion, model, runtime or candidate.
Skip the mandatory v16 institutional inventory based on the v15 result.
next_phase: Council review followed by mandatory v16 official-source institutional metadata inventory.
